overview.Name: Royalty Management Holding Corporation
overview.Description: Royalty Management Holding Corporation, a royalty building company, acquires and develops assets in various markets environments. Its portfolio includes natural resources assets, including real estate and mining permits; patents; intellectual property; and emerging technologies. The company was founded in 2021 and is based in Fishers, Indiana.
